'''George Ching-Hwuan Tiao''' ({{zh|t=刁錦寰}}; November 8, 1933 – April 25, 2026) was a Taiwanese-American [[econometrics|econometrician]] and statistician. He was a professor emeritus of economics and statistics at the [[University of Chicago Booth School of Business]]. He was the founding chair editor of ''[[Statistica Sinica]]''. He contributed greatly to the field of [[Bayesian econometrics]].

==Life and career==
Tiao was born in London while both his parents were studying at the [[London School of Economics]]<ref name="talk">{{cite journal |last1=Peña |first1=Daniel |last2=Tsay |first2=Ruey S. |title=A Conversation with George C. Tiao |journal=Statistical Science |date=1 August 2010 |volume=25 |issue=3 |doi=10.1214/09-STS292|arxiv=1101.0912 }}</ref> and raised in China. In 1950, he moved to [[Taiwan]] with his parents and studied at Nanjing Jinling High School. He earned a bachelor's degree in economics from the [[National Taiwan University]]. He moved to the United States in 1956 and earned an MBA in banking and finance from [[New York University]] in 1958. He earned his PhD in economics from the [[University of Wisconsin–Madison]] in 1962.<ref name="et">{{cite journal |last1=Chan |first1=Ngai Hang |title=The ET Interview: Professor George C. Tiao |journal=Econometric Theory |date=June 1999 |volume=15 |issue=3 |pages=389–424 |doi=10.1017/S0266466699153064 |url=https://www.cambridge.org/core/journals/econometric-theory/article/abs/et-interview-professor-george-c-tiao/04999767A756E1E0488D54691291A7A8 |language=en |issn=1469-4360|url-access=subscription }}</ref> His doctoral advisors were Roger Frederick Miller and [[George E. P. Box]].

After graduating, he worked as a faculty member for twenty years at the University of Wisconsin, serving as chair of the statistics department from 1973 to 1975.<ref name="talk" /> Since 1982, he worked at the University of Chicago Booth School of Business.

He was the founding chair editor of ''[[Statistica Sinica]]'' from 1991 to 1993.

Tiao died on April 25, 2026, at the age of 92.<ref>{{cite web |title=Official Obituary of George C. Tiao |url=https://www.lakeviewfuneralhome.com/obituaries/George-C-Tiao?obId=48274117 |website=Lakeview Funeral Home |access-date=7 May 2026}}</ref>

==Awards and honors==
Tiao became a fellow of the [[American Statistical Association]] in 1973, a fellow of the [[Institute of Mathematical Statistics]] in 1974, a member of [[Academia Sinica]] in 1976, and a member of the International Statistical Institute in 1980.<ref name="et" /> He was awarded the [[Wilks Memorial Award]] in statistics in 2001. [[Charles III University of Madrid]] awarded him an honorary doctorate in 2003.<ref name="talk" />
